title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.02875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. translated_title: 面向编码器跨语言性能提升的查询感知路由
translated_abstract: 多语言编码器在查询与相关文档语言不同时，检索效果可能会下降，尽管其在同语言场景下表现强劲。我们研究了如何在保留编码器现有同语言性能和文档索引的前提下，提升芬兰语与瑞典语的跨语言检索效果。我们将仅作用于查询端、针对冻结文档嵌入训练的低秩适配器（LoRA），与基于查询语言和索引语言的确定性路由相结合：跨语言查询使用适配器，同语言查询则使用原始编码器。SampoTron（我们微调的低秩适配器与Nemotron-3-Embed-1B模型的组合）在一个采样的金融基准上，将六个英语、芬兰语和瑞典语方向的平均检索质量从nDCG@10的0.241提升至0.291，相对提升20.9%。所有六个跨语言方向均得到改善，并且路由保留了（原有同语言性能）。
tldr: 该论文提出将仅作用于查询端的LoRA适配器与基于查询和索引语言的确定性路由相结合，在保留同语言性能和现有文档索引的同时，使英语、芬兰语、瑞典语六条跨语言检索方向的平均nDCG@10从0.241提升至0.291，相对提升20.9%。
en_tdlr: The paper combines a query-only LoRA adapter with deterministic language-based routing to improve cross-lingual retrieval across English, Finnish, and Swedish directions, achieving a 20.9% relative nDCG@10 gain while preserving same-language performance and the existing document index.
